mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO COURSE (COURSE_SEQ, COURSE_TITLE, COURSE_CONTENT, COURSE_CATEGORY, COURSE_DIFFICULT, COURSE_PRICE, COURSE_DISCOUNT, COURSE_THUMBNAIL, COURSE_TARGET, COURSE_PREPARATION, COURSE_EXPOSE, COURSE_CONFIRM_TIME, COURSE_CREATE_TIME, MEMBER_NO, COURSE_TYPE) VALUES (SEQ_COURSE.nextval, #{courseTitle},#{courseContent}, #{courseCategory},#{courseDifficult},#{coursePrice}, #{courseDiscount},#{courseThumbnail},#{courseTarget}, #{coursePreparation},'N',NULL, SYSTIMESTAMP,#{memberNo}, #{courseType})
SELECT SEQ_COURSE.currval FROM DUAl
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SECTION S LEFT JOIN CURRICULUM C ON S.SECTION_SEQ = C.SECTION_SEQ WHERE S.COURSE_SEQ = #{courseSeq} ORDER BY S.SECTION_ORDER,C.CURR_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CURRICULUM (CURR_SEQ, CURR_TITLE, CURR_VIDEO_URL, CURR_VIDEO_TYPE, CURR_PREVIEW, CURR_ORDER, SECTION_SEQ) VALUES (SEQ_CURRICULUM.nextval,#{currTitle},#{currVideoUrl},#{currVideoType},#{currPreview},#{currOrder},#{sectionSeq})
mapper.update: UPDATE COACH_APPLY SET COA_BANK = #{coaBank}, COA_BANK_NUM = #{coaBankNum}, COA_BANK_NAME = #{coaBankName}, COA_INTRO = #{coaIntro}, COA_YN = #{coaYn} WHERE COA_SEQ = #{coaSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT 'confirmedCourse' as dashKey, count(*) as dashValue FROM COURSE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND COURSE_CONFIRM_TIME IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'unconfirmedCourse' as dashKey, count(*) as dashValue FROM COURSE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND COURSE_CONFIRM_TIME IS NOT NULL UNION ALL select 'rateAverage',AVG(REVIEW_RATE) from COURSE_REVIEW WHERE COURSE_SEQ IN (SELECT COURSE_SEQ FROM COURSE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) UNION ALL select 'totalIncome', SUM(ORDERS_PRICE) from ORDERS WHERE ORDERS_STATUS = 'PAID' AND COURSE_SEQ IN (SELECT COURSE_SEQ FROM COURSE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) UNION ALL select 'onlineStudent', COUNT(*) from ORDERS WHERE COURSE_TYPE = 'ON' AND ORDERS_STATUS = 'PAID' AND COURSE_SEQ IN (SELECT COURSE_SEQ FROM COURSE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) UNION ALL select 'offlineStudent', COUNT(*) from ORDERS WHERE COURSE_TYPE = 'OFF' AND ORDERS_STATUS = 'PAID' AND COURSE_SEQ IN (SELECT COURSE_SEQ FROM COURSE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) UNION ALL select 'etcStudent', COUNT(*) from ORDERS WHERE (COURSE_TYPE NOT IN ('ON', 'OFF') OR COURSE_TYPE IS NULL) AND ORDERS_STATUS = 'PAID' AND COURSE_SEQ IN (SELECT COURSE_SEQ FROM COURSE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo})

SELECT TO_CHAR(ORDERS_TIMESTAMP, 'MM') AS MONTH, SUM(ORDERS_PRICE) AS TOTAL FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDERS_STATUS = 'PAID' AND COURSE_SEQ IN ( SELECT COURSE_SEQ FROM COURSE WHERE MEMBER_NO = 2 ) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(ORDERS_TIMESTAMP, 'MM') ORDER BY MONTH
